neighbours.label: ' and' that joins two narrated clauses with a new subject or next event ('I asked her ... and she said', 'ran it by my supervisor and he'), against ' and' joining nouns or adjectives
fire: I called the clinic to ask about the results and the nurse said they were fine.
We drove her to the vet and he gave her two shots.
My brother asked the coach if he could play and the coach told him to wait.
I showed the drawing to my teacher and she put it on the wall.
She asked the driver whether the bus stopped downtown and he shook his head.
I mentioned it to my landlord and he fixed the heater the next day.
We took the old radio to a repair shop and the man opened it on the counter.
He asked me if I had ever been to Spain and I said only once.
quiet: I called the clinic about the results for my mother and father.
We drove her to the vet in the rain with towels and blankets.
My brother asked the coach for a red and white jersey.
I showed the drawing of a cat and a dog to my teacher.
She asked the driver for a map of the bus and tram lines.
I mentioned the broken heater and window to my landlord.
We took the old radio and record player to a repair shop.
He asked me about my trips to Spain and Portugal last year.
